objective: Trigger context compaction only when it improves headroom without risking task continuity, execution correctness, or authority boundaries.

context_pressure.description: Provider/runtime reports remaining context headroom or estimated working-set pressure.
context_pressure.thresholds: provider-specific; no production threshold is approved by this draft

tool_output_inflation.description: Large logs, search results, traces or tool payloads dominate the working set after their resume-relevant facts are persisted.

manual_checkpoint.description: A future operator/harness explicitly requests compaction after a verified checkpoint.

preconditions: resolve or explicitly mark unavailable every resume-critical source reference
bind open approvals/authorization decisions by reference only
retain the minimum recent tail needed for ambiguity resolution
postconditions: all preserved fields survive exactly or as verified references
next_step remains executable or explicitly blocked
if verification is not PASS, reject compacted context and recover
recovery_order: office/control/HANDOFF.json when cross-harness context is needed
rollback: Set runtime integration disabled and use existing vfharness checkpoint/HANDOFF continuation unchanged.
